provided.reason: Presence guard takes the then branch; one supplied integer satisfies the bounded Input predicate.

absent.reason: Absent optional Input takes the explicit else branch; it is not treated as an empty or default value.

explicit-empty.reason: A supplied empty population is distinct from absence and violates exactly_one.

too-many.reason: Two supplied values violate exactly_one; cardinality is not silently truncated.

out-of-range.reason: The supplied value violates the explicit 1..10 predicate; it is not coerced or defaulted.

reason: Input presence, supplied population cardinality, and value constraints are separate dimensions; runtime binding receipts remain RI-owned.
